# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.44 (pre-release)

Two fixes found by a tester on Windows in pre.43. Written and tried by the author's assistant on one Linux machine; the automated tests pass on CI runners. **Nothing was tried by hand on Windows, macOS or arm64.**

**Fixed**
- **"Straighten curved lines" could not be ticked** once a page was selected (a page is now selected automatically when the mouse is over it): under "Settings for: this page" the change was dropped silently. Now `dewarp`, `dewarp_margin`, `dewarp_guides`, `perspective` and `erase` are kept per page (`pageN.KEY` lines in a project), like the other Output and Clean-up settings. A test covers it.
- **Text size** is also under Help (A-, A+, Auto), besides the bottom bar.
- **Auto OCR pencil** framed the whole page; it now finds the block of text in the picture (leaving out binder shadows, page borders, long rules and stray specks) and puts the zone on it. Tried on pages of a real scan seen in a screenshot; on pages with large pictures or very little text it may frame too much or too little, and the green pencil can adjust it.
- **OCR zones and ignored areas that overlap** (green and red pencils, the Auto pencil): an ignored area is now painted out of the picture before a zone is read (before, only the words found inside it were dropped afterwards, so a stamp or a rule still disturbed the reading), and the part of a zone that lies on an earlier zone is painted out of the later one, so it is read once.
- **Hand** for the zoomed preview: with "Fit" off, a "Hand" button (also Space held, or the middle mouse button) lets you drag the picture to the place you work on; drawing and editing are paused while it is on. Not tried in the window.
- The tool bar under the preview (content box, OCR pencils, Auto OCR pencil) is shown whenever a sheet is selected, not only after it has been processed.

**Read before upgrading**: project files written by this version may carry `pageN.dewarp`, `pageN.dewarp_margin`, `pageN.dewarp_guides`, `pageN.perspective` and `pageN.erase`; older versions skip such lines and lose them silently.

**Not verified**: the new per-page settings and the Help entry by hand in the window; Windows, macOS, arm64. On the macOS Intel runner (experimental) two PKCS#12 tests fail because of the runner's OpenSSL, unrelated.
